ActuationTips: Set the actuation point to activate a keypress.
RapidTriggerTips: Rapid trigger dynamically actuates and resets your key based on your intention to press or release the key. Rapid trigger starts and ends after the actuation point.
TachyonModeTips: Tachyon Mode optimizes your keyboard for input speed. When enabled, every keypress responds as fast as possible. The RGB effects are disabled and the brightness is soft capped for an optimal result. Analog stability might be affected.
FocusModeTips: Focus mode prioritizes a key group over others for faster scanning and data input speed. Key group options are top-down hardware-defined.
RpaidTriggerSensitivityTips: The sensitivity determines how much you need to release the key to deactivate it and then press to activate it again.
ContinuousRapidTriggerTips: When enabled, Rapid Trigger ends when the entire key is released. When disabled, Rapid Trigger ends at the actuation point. Enable this option if you wish to continuously spam a key without worrying about the actuation point. By default, this feature is disabled.
SelectCustomKeyTip: Please select the button you want to set.
DKSDsc: A single key achieves four functions: you can bind one to four fuctions depending on the four different press levels.
ModTapDsc: Press and hold keys to achieve different functions.
ToggleKeyDsc: Click the button to enable continuous triggering, and press and hold the button to trigger normally.
MPTDsc: A single key triggers three different keys at three different depths.
ENDDsc: A single key can send another key when released.

DebounceTimeDesc: Debounce time is time needed for contacts in mechanical switches to stabilize signal. It is often confused with usb polling rate but these are different things.
DebouncetimeDsc: Too low debounce time may cause double clicks. It is recommended to set debounce time to 5ms or higher. RMA does not cover issues with double clicks if this value is set lower than 5ms. Do you want to continue?
